title: Quality Assurance Testing Engineer
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Testing Engineer to join our team in the Mumbai Region, Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our software products through rigorous testing and validation processes. As a Quality Assurance Testing Engineer, you will be responsible for designing test plans, executing test cases, and identifying defects in software applications. You will collaborate closely with developers and product managers to understand requirements and ensure that the final product meets the highest quality standards. Key Responsibilities: - Develop and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on project requirements. - Perform functional, regression, and performance testing to ensure software quality. - Identify, document, and track defects using appropriate tools. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and provide feedback on software usability and functionality. - Participate in code reviews and provide input on testability and quality improvements. - Continuously improve testing processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of quality assurance testing methodologies and best practices. - Experience with QA testing tools and frameworks. - Ability to analyze and troubleshoot issues effectively. - Excellent communication and collaboration skills. - Detail-oriented with a strong focus on quality and accuracy. If you are passionate about quality assurance and are looking for an opportunity to contribute to a dynamic team, we encourage you to apply for this position. Join us in delivering exceptional software solutions that meet our clients' needs.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

* Work on cutting-edge AI projects with top research labs shaping the future of healthcare AI
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule from anywhere
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Contribute to meaningful work that improves how AI serves clinicians and patients

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The Digital and Technology India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, AIA Activation to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI & Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.

* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant team.

* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption

* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.

* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.

* Bachelor's in technology / bachelor's in science in a related field is required; Preferably in Business, Finance, Economics, Applied Math or related fields with quantitative training
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5-6 Years
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross-functional D&T teams.
* Technical Skillset - AI / Automation Activation, Adoption & Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization,
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy·

title: Operational Risk Officer - ICT Controls Testing
description:
**ob Title:**
Operational Risk Officer - ICT Controls Testing
  
  
**Department**
: Group RISK ORM
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
The Group RISK ORM Network Operational Risk Officer is part of the Group RISK Function within BNP Paribas. The department has responsibility for steering and reporting on the Group’s Operational Risk Management framework and status. It is the independent second line of defense on operational risk management activities of the Group, including on Information and Communication Technology risk management activities.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
RISK Operational Risk Management (RISK ORM), created early 2021 to oversee operational risks within the mandate of the RISK function, is organized, under the responsibility of the Group Chief Operational Risk Officer (Group CORO), around 3 Poles: RISK ORM Framework, RISK ORM Technology & Transversal Risks and RISK ORM Network. Under the authority of the Pole’s Manager, RISK ORM Network is made up of all the Operational Risk Officers (OROs) acting as the second line of defense (LoD2) within the Group’s operational entities (Poles, Business Lines, Functions, Transversal Activities). The below requirement is for Operational Risk Officer- ICT Controls Testing role which part of the Common ICT LoD2 Controls Execution Platform (CICEP) under Group RISK ORM Network team. The candidate will be part of The Bank’s 2nd line of defense function, and they will be responsible for testing the deployment, and effectiveness of the IT and Cyber controls globally. The position is based in India Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (ISPL), Mumbai and reports to the Head of CICEP (India CoE), plus functionally to Group Head of ICT Controls Testing. Key success of the CICEP relies on building trusted partnerships with stakeholders and particularly with the ORM Network community and globally, with all entities of the Group.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Perform the independent testing of ICT controls (ITGC controls testing) to determine the design effectiveness, and operating effectiveness of IT and Cyber controls.
* Contribute to the industrialization / automation of RISK ORM ICT control testing services by development of methodologies / tools for the achievement of assignments.
* Draft high-quality reports containing the assessor’s opinion on the ICT control gaps, and recommendations for improvement/mitigation, post completion of an assignment.
* Review and assist with the evaluation of control deficiencies and provide practical recommendations for remediation.
* Identify areas of improvement for ICT control testing and assist with the enhancement of the methodologies / tools for carrying out the ICT controls testing assignments.
* Ensure completion of the testing and adherence to the internal timelines.
* Provide IT and cyber risk management consultancy (specific to ICT controls) to business and IT stakeholders.
* Work in collaboration with other stakeholders from business and RISK ORM teams to contribute towards influencing the ICT risk culture of The Bank
* Improve the effectiveness of the Internal Controls programme by reviewing the risk posture control environment, risk assessment process, control activities, information and communication and monitoring activities

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaboration at the India CoE level with Head of India CoE, including but not limited to the CoE level reporting requirements
* Effectively contribute to the CoE, RISK India Hub and ISPL on Group mandates, Objectives and priorities
* Help and contribute to build the CoE as a positive place to work

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Skills Required**
SKILLS, EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES
  
  

* 4-9 years of experience in IT audit / ITGC /ITAC controls testing / technical assessments, preferably in the areas of Cyber and Technology domains in a financial institution.
* Must be able to interface, coordinate, work efficiently, and effectively with business partners.
* Excellent analytical skills - being able to come to a thoughtful and business focused solution.

title: Agent Engineer - Evals and Harness
description:
Lexsi Labs is the leading frontier AI lab focused on building aligned, interpretable, and safe superintelligent systems. While that is the vision, the mission is to build safety aware autonomous systems in the extreme near term. Our research work spans areas like AI alignment methodologies, interpretability-led system design, and foundational model research across structured, tabular, and new autonomous system designs. We published about 25+ papers in the past 15 months across leading conferences including ICLR, ICML, WWW, IJCNN, MICCAI and EurIPS. Our labs are located in India (Mumbai and remote), Paris, and London.

We operate with a flat structure, high autonomy, and a strong bias toward engineers who take full ownership of what they build, from architecture to production behavior.

The Role

Our current sprint on building autonomous systems for complex problems, across software engineering, data science, and AI research, involves building the harness, execution substrate and evaluation system, and each is designed to run inside a customer's environment rather than ours.

This role sits underneath all three agents. The coding agent, the data science agent and the AI engineering agent look different from the outside, but they are the same system underneath: a loop that plans, acts, observes, recovers, and knows when to stop. You will build that shared layer, and the evaluation system that tells us whether any change to it made things better. Both halves matter equally. A harness we cannot measure is a harness we cannot improve.

****What you'll work on:****

Harness

* The core agent loop and its execution model, covering orchestration, concurrency, sub-agent coordination, cancellation, timeouts, checkpointing and resume.
* Context and state management for long-running tasks, including retention, compaction, and how an agent reasons over what it has already done.
* The shared tool protocol, its schemas, versioning, and the internal libraries every agent team builds against.
* The execution substrate. Sandboxed environments that are reproducible, snapshot-able and resource-bounded, and that behave identically for a repository task, a training run and a data analysis.
* Failure semantics. Retry policy, partial failure, idempotency, and the distinction between a recoverable error and a task that should stop and hand back.
* The trace schema every agent emits, which serves at once as our debugging surface, our training signal, and the audit record our customers keep.
  
  

Evals

* Task suites for each agent type, built from real work rather than synthetic benchmarks, and the infrastructure to run them at scale in parallel.
* Verifiers and scoring. Deterministic checks where the task allows it, model-graded rubrics where it does not, and calibration of the graders themselves.
* Regression gates that run on every harness change, with cost and latency accounted alongside quality.
* The statistics to say a result is real. Seeds, variance, pass@k, confidence, and knowing how many runs are needed before anyone claims an improvement.
* Turning observed production failures into permanent test cases.
* Tooling for how we work. Trace inspection, replay, and diffing one run against another.
  
  

You will work across all three agent teams and closely with our research team on evaluation design, post-training and interpretability of agent behavior.

What We Are Looking For

This is a systems and infrastructure role. Most of the difficulty here is concurrency, state and measurement, not prompting.

* Strong software engineering fundamentals and advanced Python. You have shipped and operated production services, not only written them.
* Concurrency and distributed systems. Async execution, worker pools and queues, retries and idempotency, backpressure, cancellation, and reasoning clearly about what happens when a step fails halfway through.
* Containers and sandboxing. Docker and OCI internals, resource isolation, reproducible environments, and an understanding of why a job that passes locally fails in a sandbox.
* Test and CI infrastructure. You have built test harnesses, run large suites in parallel, and dealt with flakiness as an engineering problem rather than an annoyance.
* Measurement literacy. Comfort with variance, sampling and significance, and healthy skepticism toward benchmark results including your own.
* Observability instincts. Distributed tracing, structured logging, and building the inspection tooling that makes non-deterministic systems debuggable.
* You debug systematically. You find out what actually happened rather than adjusting things until the symptom disappears.
* You are comfortable when problems are loosely specified and ownership is assumed rather than assigned.
* Experience with evaluation or benchmarking work for AI systems is a strong plus.
* Experience with agentic systems, LLM inference and serving, or developer tooling is a plus.
* Open source contributions we can read are a plus.
  
  

We are hiring several engineers for this team at a range of experience levels, including engineers early in their careers who have strong fundamentals and want to work on agents from the infrastructure side.

We move quickly and expect candidates to do the same. We value substance over polish and execution over rhetoric.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

- Exposure to Fintech or BFSI domains.

title: QA/ QC- Real estate
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented QA/QC professional to join our Real Estate development team. The QA/QC Specialist will be responsible for ensuring that all real estate projects, from conception to completion, adhere to the highest quality standards, regulatory requirements, and project specifications. This role involves developing, implementing, and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes across various stages of property development and construction.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop, implement, and maintain comprehensive Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) plans, procedures, and standards for all real estate projects.
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits at various stages of construction (e.g., foundation, structural, MEP, finishes) to ensure compliance with design specifications, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
* Review architectural, structural, and MEP drawings, specifications, and other project documents to identify potential quality issues and ensure constructability and adherence to standards.
* Identify, document, and report non\-conformities, defects, and deviations from quality standards, recommending appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions, ensuring timely resolution of identified issues.
* Collaborate closely with project managers, contractors, subcontractors, architects, and engineers to foster a culture of quality and ensure seamless execution of quality protocols.
* Prepare detailed QA/QC reports, inspection checklists, and documentation for all project phases, maintaining accurate records for audit and compliance purposes.
* Participate in material inspections, testing, and approval processes to ensure that all materials used meet specified quality criteria.
* Provide training and guidance to project teams and contractors on quality standards, procedures, and best practices.
* Assist in the final handover process, including snagging lists and defect liability period inspections, ensuring all issues are resolved to client satisfaction.
* Stay updated with the latest industry standards, building codes, and quality management systems relevant to real estate and construction.

Our best\-in\-class offering includes accounting and investors services, portfolio analytics, middle\-office functions, regulatory and financial reporting, and tax services. Delivering these services to our clients and their investors is a diverse team of 1,400 highly skilled employees across the globe based in New York, London, Glasgow, Dublin, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hong Kong. Joining MSFS, you will discover a dynamic environment where every day offers new opportunities for personal growth and innovation. Here at MSFS your career isn’t just a job, it’s an incredible journey fueled by collaboration, challenge, and the chance to make a meaningful impact to our business, our clients, their investors and the wider Morgan Stanley franchise.
   

  

 The Product Development team is the engine at the heart of our MSFS technology ecosystem, ensuring our platforms perform seamlessly for clients and colleagues every day while leading transformative changes across our business. Through the team’s deep partnership with our Technology department, they are reimagining how we work and how clients and their investors engage with MSFS. This team enables breakthrough innovation and an elevated user experience. Product Development is also at the forefront of adopting advanced technologies, including robotics and artificial intelligence, to deliver greater scale, efficiency, and operational excellence for MSFS and its stakeholders.
   

  

 The current opening is for the Client Computing Solutions (CCS) Team which is part of Product Development function. The CCS Team develops tools to resolve complex business problems that are overwhelming and error\-prone if handled manually by front\-line colleagues. Complexity is often found in areas such as investor services, investor allocation, regulatory reporting, capital activities and trade transaction management. The Team is comprised of colleagues who have had solid technical education and have studied finance and accounting as the chosen field to apply the skills. The CCS Team tends to focus on very complex, specific and urgent circumstances, and the solutions tend to be highly customized for the clients concerned, and rapid turnaround is usually a requirement.

**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* Knowledge of databases, database concepts with ability to handle large data\-set will be a plus
* Strong project management skills with ability to take ownership \& lead projects independently with minimum supervision
* Working knowledge of project management tools like JIRA, Rally or any other in\-house developed tools
* Strong communication skills \& ability to interface with executive management, business users and technology development teams in multiple locations
* Should be detailed oriented and must have strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Experience of working with multiple stakeholders for prioritisation and tracking of requirements
* Inclination to manage/supervise people and work as part of focused globally distributed teams, in a complex matrix environment
* Ability to handle pressure, effectively prioritize and handle multiple tasks with high level of accuracy
* Proactive, positive, self\-motivated \& a good team player


**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. * Workflow configuration and the background jobs that drive deadline monitoring and error recovery.

* Flexible Workflow in S/4HANA \- scenario activation, preconditions and step configuration.

* Object\-Oriented ABAP (Design Patterns) \- classes, interfaces, inheritance and exception handling.
* Debugging, code optimisation and performance tuning.

title: Quality Control Engineer
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 We are looking for a QC Engineer to ensure the quality of technology built for financial services, where accuracy and reliability matter. You will turn product requirements into clear, thorough test cases and back them up with automated unit and integration tests. You will work closely with developers and product owners from the start of each feature, so that quality is built in rather than checked at the end.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Study requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria, and clarify gaps or ambiguities early.
* Write structured test scenarios and test cases covering positive, negative and edge cases.
* Write unit test cases for individual functions, modules and services.
* Write integration tests that verify APIs, databases and services work correctly together.
* Maintain a requirement\-to\-test traceability matrix so every requirement is covered.
* Execute regression cycles, log defects with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes.
* Integrate automated tests into the CI pipeline and report on test coverage and quality.
* Use AI tools to speed up test case writing and test data creation, reviewing everything for correctness.



  





**REQUIRED SKILLS** 




**Requirement Analysis** 




 Ability to break down requirements and acceptance criteria into testable conditions.
 



**Test Design** 




 Equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables and state transitions.
 



**Unit Testing** 




 Jest / Vitest / Mocha for JavaScript and pytest for Python; mocking and stubbing.
 



**Integration Testing** 




 API testing with Supertest, FastAPI TestClient, Postman/Newman; test data setup.
 



**Databases** 




 Basic SQL to validate data in PostgreSQL/MySQL; familiarity with MongoDB queries.
 



**Programming** 




 Working knowledge of JavaScript and/or Python to write and maintain test code.
 



**AI** 




 Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) to draft test cases and test code; able to spot gaps and errors in AI output.
 



**Tools \& Process** 




 Jira (or similar) for defects, Git, CI/CD basics, and Agile/Scrum ways of working.
 



  





**GOOD TO HAVE** 



* End\-to\-end automation (Playwright/Cypress), performance testing (k6/JMeter), or mobile app testing.
* Basic knowledge of stock market concepts such as order types, margins and settlement; experience testing AI\-powered features.



  





**WHAT WE LOOK FOR** 



* A genuine interest in finance, capital markets and investing, and curiosity about how financial products work.
* A degree in Computer Science/IT or equivalent; ISTQB certification is a plus.
* A sharp eye for detail, a curious "what could break?" mindset, and clear written communication.

description:
**Role \- Quality Assurance Engineer 3** 




**Location \- Nahur, Mumbai** 




**5 days work from office** 




  





**About Us** 




 We are surrounded by the world's leading consumer companies led by technology \- Amazon for retail, Airbnb for hospitality, Uber for mobility, Netflix and Spotify for entertainment, etc. Food \& Beverage is the only consumer sector where large players are still traditional restaurant companies. At Rebel Foods, we are challenging this status quo as we are building the world's most valuable restaurant company on the internet, superfast.
 



 The opportunity for us is immense due to the exponential growth in the food delivery business worldwide which has helped us build 'The World's Largest Internet Restaurant Company' in the last few years. Rebel Foods' current presence in India, UAE \& UK with close to 50 brands and 4500\+ internet restaurants has been built on The Rebel Operating System.
 



 While for us it is still Day 1, we know we are in the middle of a revolution towards creating never seen before customer\-first experiences. We bring you a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to disrupt the 500\-year\-old industry with technology at its core.
 



 We urge you to refer to the below to understand how we are changing the restaurant industry before applying at Rebel Foods.
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/why\-is\-rebel\-foods\-hiring\-super\-talented\-engineers\-b88586223ebe

 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/winning\-the\-last\-frontier\-for\-consumer\-internet\-5f2a659c43db
 



 https://spirit.rebelfoods.com/a\-unique\-take\-on\-food\-tech\-dcef8c51ba41
 



  





**Software Engineering @ Rebel**




 Software Engineering @ Rebel comprises of most of the components of a customer\-centric internet commerce company and problem statements of scalable and distributed systems. We believe in applying engineering excellence and operational excellence in all the areas of compute, storage, network to build \& operate efficient systems. While we work on open\-source, cloud\-managed and enterprise tech stacks in Frontend (web/mobile), Backend (API layers), Caching, Async Processing/Queuing, Databases (SQL,NoSQL), ERP, CRM, Analytics, Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB etc), Data Science (ML) etc, we also work/evaluate on many emerging tech stacks like NLP, AI/IOT, Robotics \+ Automations, Bots, Voice, Vision computing, Blockchain etc to solve many use cases around different verticals of FoodTech. The teams have built more than 30 different systems in\-house to tackle the massive complexity of a multi\-brand operation while keeping business metrics supremely efficient and optimized.
 



  





**Future of Software Engineering @ Rebel**




 Rebel Engineering function is working on Software \+ Robotics \+ Automation to solve the toughest problems in an integrated fashion for our customers and to make their food experiences unique, memorable and delightful \& sure. We believe in continuous adoption of emerging technologies to solve customer problems in fast and innovative fashion. Technology and data are the backbone for us to disrupt this industry and build the most loved experiences for customers.
 



**The Role**




 We are on the lookout for a Lead QA who is passionate about using technology to solve known and unknown business and customer use cases. We want someone who can look at a business problem from the end user's perspective, believes in building and delivering quality products, and can lead others to do the same.
 



 In this role, you will own end\-to\-end quality for backend and integration services that have no user interface. Around 60–70% of the work involves validating system behaviour through logs and monitoring tools. You will analyse application logs in ELK to confirm that the correct API calls are happening with the right payloads and sequencing, trace requests across microservices using Datadog APM, and debug issues in services hosted on AWS. You will be responsible for test strategy, planning and release sign\-off. You will also test third\-party integrations for contract correctness, data consistency, retries, timeouts and failure scenarios, prepare regression and sanity suites, and run Linux commands and write SQL queries to verify logs, production issues and data.
 



 On the automation side, you will contribute to, scale and improve our existing API automation frameworks (Java, RestAssured), and design new frameworks from scratch when needed. You should have hands\-on knowledge of Jenkins and Docker to integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines, and be able to plan and run performance tests using JMeter or similar tools. As a lead, you will mentor and guide QA engineers, review their test plans and automation code, define and report quality metrics, and drive adoption of AI\-assisted testing practices. We expect you to be a strong problem solver and an out\-of\-the\-box thinker.
 



 Exposure to common technologies such as web technologies, caching, queuing, databases (SQL), storage systems, monitoring tools and cloud technologies is also helpful.
 



 You will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams and will report to the Engineering Manager – QA.
 



**The Rebel Culture**




 We believe in empowering and growing people to perform the best at their job functions. We follow outcome\-oriented, fail\-fast iterative \& collaborative culture to move fast in building tech solutions. Rebel is not a usual workplace. Organizations worldwide depend on the data Vertiv helps to power and cool.

 The Switchgear Testing Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Thane. The engineer will prepare detailed test plans and test cases, set up test equipment, conduct functional and routine tests, and document test results accurately. * Strong foundation in Testing methodologies with hands\-on exposure to Functional Testing of electrical equipment.
* Degree in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Knowledge of relevant IEC/IEEE standards for switchgear and electrical safety.
* Proficiency in using electrical testing instruments (e.g., multimeters, insulation testers, relay test kits).
* Attention to detail, structured documentation skills, and ability to interpret electrical drawings and schematics.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills for working with cross\-functional engineering and production teams.
* Experience in a manufacturing or testing environment for power distribution equipment is an advantage.
* Commitment to safe work practices and adherence to company quality procedures.

title: Manager Quality - Energy
description:
**John Cockerill, enablers of opportunities**
 Driven since 1817 by the entrepreneurial spirit and thirst for innovation of its founder, the John Cockerill Group develops large\-scale technological solutions to meet the needs of our time: facilitating access to
   

  

 low\-carbon energies, enabling sustainable industrial production, preserving natural resources, contributing to greener mobility, enhancing security and installing essential infrastructures.
   

  

 Its offer to companies, governments and communities consists of services and associated equipment for the sectors of energy, defense, industry, environment, transport and infrastructures.
   

  

 With more than 8 200 employees, John Cockerill achieved a turnover of € 1\.649 billion in 2025 in 27 countries, on 5 continents.
   

  

 Location \- Mumbai, India
   

  

**Overview**
 Job Purpose
   

  

 The Quality Engineer is a working employee who is a key representative of the project team, and also of the Customers and Suppliers, for all topics related to project quality aspect. He/She is in charge of the completeness and compliance to the contract of the quality documentation of the project from the award of an order to the provisional acceptance of the equipment. The Quality Engineer is particularly responsible to issue the ITP (Inspection and Test Plan) of the project and to follow up the quality documentation of the Suppliers taking an important part in the Supply Chain Process as defined in the QMS (Quality Management System) of the Energy Sector.
   

  

 The Quality Engineer is responsible to verify that all required tests have been performed as per the Standards and the contract. As per the hold and witness points of the ITP, he/she could possibly assist to the inspections and tests (pressure, functional and performance tests) at the Suppliers’ facility.
   

  

 He/she will review and comment all the quality documentation of all purchased commodities.
   

  

 He/she will issue the quality release for each equipment when the required quality level demanded by the project is met.
   

  

 Objectives
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The Quality Engineer is responsible for the quality of the products purchased for the project he/she is in charge. He/she will also be responsible of the review of the quality documentation of the purchased products. He/she is under the hierarchical responsibility of the Quality Manager and the functional responsibility of the Project Manager with the following objectives:
   

  

* Customer satisfaction,
* Conformance to applicable codes and norms, directives, contractual scope of supply, Customer’s technical specifications, internal standards and local regulations, in regards to the quality of the equipment and the fabrication
* Quality, conformity and completeness of the quality documentation,
* Respect of timely quality documentation issuance and review of delivery schedules.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**The Duties Of The Quality Engineer Are Amongst Others**
* Analysis of contractual quality specifications,
* Privilege contact of the project team for all quality aspects,
* Defend John Cockerill’s interests in an appropriate way in front of Customers and Suppliers,
* Development and issue of the Inspection and Tests Plans of the projects he/she is assigned,
* Writing of quality specifications (additional requirements on raw materials, fabrication procedures, repair procedures…),
* Participation to technical negotiations and kick\-off meeting (KOM) with Suppliers,
* Participation to kick\-off meeting with Customers for quality aspects,
* Check of the conformity of quality documentation of Suppliers (Quality Plans, WPS/PQR, NDT procedures, NDT reports…) during project execution from KOM to the completion of the MDB (Manufacturing Data Book),
* Follow up of inspection notifications and coordination/participation with Customers with project management,
* Participate to inspections and tests at Suppliers’ Yard when judged necessary.
* Privilege contact of local workshop Quality Supervisors,
* Follow up of non\-conformities and action plans of Suppliers,
* Issue of Quality Release reports,
* Privilege contact of Site Supervisor for all site quality issues,
* Ensure appliance certification of the equipment stamping such as (but not limited) ASME stamp and CE marking when applicable.
* Coordination of possible Third Parties (AI, NoBo…) involved in the project,
* Preparation of the documentation for regulation registration of products (National Board for instance),
* When applicable, verification that all the documentation required by the code/norm or directive are reviewed by the third party (AI for ASME, NoBo for PED…)
* Participation to qualification process of new Suppliers,
* Technical risks assessments,
* Application of internal standards and good practices,  Promotion and implementation of continuous improvement.


 The Quality Engineer reports directly to the Quality Manager.
   

  

 Education \& Experience
   

  

* 10\-15 years’ experience
* Bachelor of Engineering (Welding Technology / Mechanical / Production / Metallurgy / Material)  Certification from AWS / AM\-IIW in Welding Technology


 Background, Skills and Competencies
   

  

 The Quality Engineer has a generalist profile. He/she must be available for temporary missions, sometimes on short notice, including international travel.
   

  

**He/she Adheres To The Essential Values Of John Cockerill**
* Human
* Committed
* Innovative
* Responsible  Customer oriented


**His/her Soft Skills Are**
* Team spirit
* Information sharing
* Collaboration
* Detailed focus
* Decision taking
* Rigorous
* Results oriented
* Organized
* Schedule oriented
* Problem solving
* Comfortable with international contacts and relationships
* Ability to work under pressure
* Assertiveness


**His/her Technical Skills Are**
* Analysis of contractual requirements in regards with internal standards (mainly ASME, EN and ISO codes)
* Understanding of international codes and norms
* Understanding of international regulations for John Cockerill’s products (mainly


 European Pressure Equipment Directive and ASME)
   

  

* Knowledge on steel material properties
* Knowledge of welding processes
* Knowledge of NDT (Non Destructive Testing)
* Ability to read mechanical and electrical drawings
* Application of internal technical choices
* Understanding of his professional environment
* Understanding of product and organization interfaces
* Fluent in English (reading, speaking, listening)
* Fluent in French is a plus


 Who We Are
   

  

 John Cockerill Energy, a player in the energy transition: the strength of a diversified and combinable range of solutions
   

  

 It Is From The Heart Of Its History Stretching Back More Than 200 Years That John Cockerill Energy Draws Its Expertise In The Production Of Steam, Which Has Led To It Being Recognized Worldwide On The Market For The Conception And Supply Of Heat Recuperation Boilers. Resolutely Turned Towards The Future. We Proudly Incarnate The Bold Spirit Of An Entrepreneur And We Have Extended Our Know\-how To Respond To The Needs Of Our Times, By Developing Innovative Solutions To Encourage Access To Energy, Just Like Our Founder In His Own Times
   

  

* Heat Recovery steam generators, particularly suited to operate in cycles with frequent start\-ups and shut\-downs. They can be installed behind gas turbines of all power ratings, brands and burning all types of fuel;
* The manufacture and maintenance of boiler parts, in particular pressure parts in its specialized workshop based in Mexico.
* Aftersales services, technical assistance, inspections from the rehabilitation to the modernization of all types and brands of boilers.
* Wet \& dry cooling with cooling towers and air\-cooled condensers for power plants.
* Thermal solar receivers (Concentrated Solar Power), that capture the sun’s rays, reflected by mirrors on the ground, and enable to produce energy 24/7 thanks to molten salts.
* Industrial boilers destined for sectors such as chemicals, petrochemicals, biomass, incineration, …


 It is from this knowledgeable mix of tradition and innovation that we draw our own energy. And it is across the whole world that John Cockerill Energy makes its mark through its technological know\-how and its mastery of project management thanks to our Belgian, American and Mexican teams and our recuperation boiler licensees, Wuxi, S\&T and Larsen \& Toubro which respectively cover China, South Korea and India. Together, we all work to facilitate access to green energy. Visit us at Energy \- John Cockerill to know more.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity Employer
   

  

 John Cockerill and all John Cockerill Companies are equal opportunity employers that evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), age, marital status, disability, veteran status, citizenship status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and other characteristics protected by law.
   

  

 John Cockerill offers you career and development opportunities within its various sectors in a friendly working environment.
   

  

 Do you want to work for an innovative company that will allow you to take up technical challenges on a daily basis?
   

  

 We look forward to receiving your application and to meeting you!
   

  

 Discover our job opportunities in details on Career \- John Cockerill

**About Business line/Function:** 
 ITG provides testing services for the BNP Paribas Group. The Security testing team is responsible for executing SAST, Penetration Tests (Black or Gray Box) for the Web and Mobile applications pertaining to the group.
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 The purpose of the position is to help with the Mobile security testing activities mentioned in the direct responsibilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* To perform Penetration testing (Gray Box and/or Black Box) for Web applications, Mobile, API, and thick client applications.

* Perform Static analysis (SAST) and Dynamic analysis (DAST) on Android APKs and iOS IPA to identify insecure storage, hardcoded secrets, insecure configurations, runtime hooking, parameter tampering etc
* Conduct reverse engineering and protection bypass on mobile applications including decompiling /inspecting binaries, analyzing native libraries (.so/.dylib) and bypassing client\-side protections (root / jailbreak detection, SSL pinning, obfuscation, tamper checks etc.) using tools like Frida, objection magisk, cydia/selio/zebra and Xposed.

* Ensure execution of the documented security scenarios for the application under test.
* Document and report all findings.
* Collaborate with the developers to help them understand the vulnerabilities reported in application.
* Escalate issues to the local management and onshore stakeholders in case it affects the testing progress.
* Ensure processes for the project is followed for the assessments.

* Mandatory requirement – Mobile, Web \& API Penetration Testing

* Strong in verbal and written communication
* Good analytical skills
* Strong Time Management

* Team player

 CSSLP/CEH or equivalent certification preferred.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Sia is a next\-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.
   

  





 With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
   

  

  

  

 Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Sia’s AI Factory (AIF), embedded directly within a client’s engineering, product, or service team. The FDE is a hybrid role that pairs hands\-on software engineering with client\-facing delivery, sitting close to the client to close platform gaps and ship production use cases in parallel, rather than working at arm’s length through a traditional delivery layer.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work embedded full\-time within the client’s engineering, product, or service team, participating directly in their planning, standups, and delivery cadence.


* Close platform gaps in real time: build the missing components, connectors, or tooling the client’s platform doesn’t yet provide.


* Deliver production use cases in parallel with platform build\-out, balancing near\-term delivery pressure against longer\-term platform health.


* Integrate with the client’s approved tools, APIs, and governance frameworks (e.g. controlled AI gateways) rather than introducing external dependencies.


* Communicate technical trade\-offs and blockers directly to client stakeholders, translating between Sia’s team and the client’s engineering leadership.


* Collaborate within a cross\-functional pod (client engineers, platform engineers, Sia engineers) in an agile/SCRUM setup.


* Escalate platform or scope risks early. FDE roles sit at the point where client demand and platform maturity meet.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


* Experience \& Technical Skills:


* Strong Python skills, with production engineering experience, not limited to prototyping.


* Comfortable operating embedded within a client or external stakeholder team, with less structure/definition than an internal team typically has.


* Ability to quickly understand an unfamiliar codebase or platform and contribute production\-quality code within it.


* Experience with agent orchestration, RAG/LLM\-based applications, and tool/API integration is a strong plus.


* SiaGPT or comparable GenAI platform experience is a strong plus.


* Comfort working within governed enterprise environments (approved libraries/APIs/services, controlled AI gateways).


* Good to have: Spark, Databricks, AWS.


* Good to have: prior experience in regulated or enterprise domains (e.g. financial services, healthcare, or public sector).


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**



* Opportunity to lead cutting\-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.



**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**




 Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

 commissioning

* Assess and identify the training requirement of study team and ensure completion of training.
* Well versed with electronic systems used in Clinical Trial operations, Data Management and Project Management which includes project specific deliverables tracking and important milestone related alarms, protocol compliance tracking, deviations tracking and electronic systems used for managing Trial Master File (TMF) and Drug accountability.
* Assist in developing system/process to work with the clinical trial team to schedule pre\-execution and post\-execution QC activities to ensure that all requirements of the QC plans are planned as required and executed.
* Plan, design, and update process and systems for clinical trial activities like development and utilization of QC assessment parameters and other QC tools designed to document/track the QC review process for clinical research activities in line with recent regulatory requirement.
* Ensure Quality Management System at Medical Science, Data Management team, Operation team to ensure the department is ready for audit/inspection 24x7\.
* Ensure periodic review of Vendors and renewals as per applicable policies \& procedures.
* Identify and recommend process improvement initiatives where required.
* Create and evaluate metrics to assess performance and implement plans for course correction.


**Activities**
* Should be effective team player who can work closely with different study teams and collaborate well with team members to achieve defined QC targets.
* Develop and implement a risk\-based and flexible approach to Quality Compliance (QC) within the function, which will ensure that trial participants and data are safeguarded in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and best practices.
* Identify and decide team member’s job specific SOP training requirements in view of their role and maintain oversight of training to ensure all team members are trained on each SOP as required.
* Preparation of SOPs related to QC function and support in review of SOPs specific to Medical science, Clinical team and Data Management team.
* Quality review of the clinical trial medical science related activities like Synopsis, Protocol, Clinical Study Report (CSR) and appendices, and SOPs in line with ICH GCP requirement, Indian and global regulatory requirement.
* Quality review of the clinical trial operation related activities, related tools, plans and documentation like site feasibility, site selection visit, site initiation, Ethic committee documentation, monitoring – site specific reports, Site Documents, logs and close out activities in line with ICH GCP requirement, Indian and global regulatory requirement.
* Ensure Quality review of SOPs and oversight on quality parameters specific to Clinical Trial Supply Management (CTSM) and other activities like receipt, handling of study sample, labelling, storage, temperature monitoring systems and distribution to trial sites.
* Final QC review of study close out activities including returned goods reconciliation, inventory destruction processing and archiving of documents.
* Review and communication of QC findings to respective department in stipulated timelines.

* Ensure training of SOPs, on job training and reviewing training files on regular basis.
* QC review and Support in preparation of clinical study manuals/documents/Plan such as the IMP handling manual, Study plans.
* Ensure record maintenance for all activities for traceability in line with regulatory requirement.

 Bachelor's or Masters degree in a health or related field, such as Biology, Chemistry, Nursing, Pharmacy, or Public Health and/or Post\-graduate Diploma in Clinical Research
   

  

**Experience**
 Relevant experience of 5 years in the field of Clinical Research.
   

  

**Additional Skills**

* Strong eye for detail and ability to spot inconsistencies a must and good conflict management skills.
* Must have experience in handling audits \& inspections of DCGI, US FDA.

title: Senior Product Enablement Associate - Internal Audit
description:
**Job Description**
**Internal Audit (IA)** 
 is an independent function at JPMorganChase that aims to enhance and protect the firm by providing risk\-based and objective assurance, advice, and insight. We work with every Line of Business and Corporate Function to assess the internal control processes that drive our global business, identifying areas of improvement to help safeguard the firm.
   

  

**IA Product Management** 
 is part of Audit, Strategy, Innovation and Practices (ASIP) and is a single, accountable organization that brings collective expertise together to own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of Internal Audit products and deliver consistent, high\-quality audit outcomes. In partnership with Audit Tech and stakeholders, it governs delivery, manages demand and change, and monitors product health (availability, performance, defects) to ensure reliable tools and a seamless user experience and also champions IA's data\-first strategy by improving data quality, enrichment, and usability to enable analytics, data\-driven audit decisions, and greater business impact.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Customer Success Associate** 
 within
 **IA Product Management** 
 , you will develop and maintain strong relationships with internal customers (audit teams and stakeholders). You will also elevate the customer journey by translating product insights into trusted partnerships and enabling Internal Audit teams to realize value from ASIP products through proactive engagement, onboarding, and continuous improvement. You'll support adoption and retention of key audit products by running enablement, gathering feedback, tracking success metrics, and partnering with Product and Technology teams to improve user experience and outcomes. This role is based in Mumbai and requires strong stakeholder management, structured execution, and comfort operating in a matrixed organization.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end product support ticket intake, triage, and execution through closure: capture accurate topic/module details; resolve user\-education/standard requests where possible; route potential defects to product owners; ensure required tagging (team \+ category); and close the loop with users on outcomes and timelines.
* Monitor and improve service performance by tracking ticket volumes, aging (e.g., average days open), and resolution patterns; identify bottlenecks and drive operational improvements.
* Translate feedback into actionable prioritization inputs by consolidating feedback into clear problem statements, tracking requests through status, and supporting feature request governance and follow\-through.
* Support AI/ML lifecycle governance and model monitoring by coordinating required intake/approvals, maintaining documentation and control evidence, partnering with model owners on periodic performance/health reviews (e.g., drift, data quality, stability), and tracking remediation actions through to closure.
* Provide operational communications across incidents, service updates, and operational changes; tailor messaging to user groups and ensure consistent updates through resolution.
* Support access management operations across onboarding/offboarding: monitor provisioning/deprovisioning performance, handle exceptions, and ensure controls are executed consistently; perform BAU access activities to free leadership capacity for strategic work.
* Monitor business and technical data quality by reviewing exceptions based on thresholds (e.g., completeness, accuracy, timeliness), including Business Data Quality (BDQ) / Technical Data Quality (TDQ) monitoring as scope grows; analyze exceptions, follow up, and translate trends/root causes with Technology and data owners into prioritized remediation.
* End\-to\-end data management: establish governance policies, drive data quality (profiling, controls, issue/RCA, KPIs), manage metadata (glossary, lineage, catalog adoption), and enforce data lifecycle practices (classification, retention, archival, disposal).
* Support audit support tool monitoring in APAC to enable a follow\-the\-sun support model, including monitoring, exception triage/follow\-ups, and timely user support outside US hours.
* Coordinate across partners (Product, Technology, Controls, Audit Teams) to drive follow\-ups, manage escalations, and close the loop with customers.
* Support product\-led initiatives as needed by driving execution tracking, managing dependencies, and coordinating stakeholders through closure.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* 7\+ years of experience (or equivalent expertise) in customer success, business management, chief of staff, client services, product operations, program coordination, or stakeholder\-facing roles within product/technology environments.
* Demonstrated ability to influence adoption through enablement, relationship\-building, and structured follow\-through.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders across levels and functions.
* Proven ability to learn new technologies quickly and enable others through demos, documentation, and training.
* SQL proficiency \- write queries to inspect, analyze, and validate data across database tables.
* Data Profiling \- ability to perform data profiling, anomalies in the data and then root cause analysis on the Data Quality Issues.
* Define and execute the operating model for business glossary, metadata standards, lineage coverage, data quality controls, and governance.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with risk, controls, audit, governance, or other regulated/controlled environments.
* Experience creating lightweight reporting and insights; summarizing themes into executive\-ready updates.
* Experience partnering with Product/Technology teams on incident triage, root\-cause themes, and continuous improvement follow\-ups.
* Deeper data modeling/architecture knowledge, hands\-on experience with data catalog/lineage/DQ/MDM tools, BI/analytics fluency, Agile/product delivery, and change\-management.

description:
**Company Description** 
 Interior Company, a subsidiary of Square Yards, operates across multiple locations in India and the UAE, focusing on home construction and interior design. The team is composed of skilled professionals who are passionate about construction, interior aesthetics, and functional design. The company aims to deliver a seamless and hassle\-free experience by combining client preferences with expert guidance. Interior Company is committed to creating living spaces that reflect each client’s personality and style while maintaining high standards of quality and craftsmanship.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Mumbai for Drawing Quality Check in Interior Fit\-out projects, with compensation up to 6 LPA. The role involves reviewing and verifying interior fit\-out drawings for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with design standards and client requirements. The team member will check dimensions, materials, and specifications, identify inconsistencies, and coordinate with designers and project managers to resolve discrepancies. Daily responsibilities include maintaining quality documentation, ensuring compliance with internal quality guidelines, and supporting smooth execution of projects by providing clear, timely feedback on drawings. The role also requires collaboration with cross\-functional teams to ensure that approved drawings are ready for implementation on site.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret technical drawings, identify errors, and assess design feasibility.
* Candidates should possess Quality Control and Quality Assurance skills to ensure drawings meet company standards, client specifications, and regulatory requirements.
* Candidates should possess Quality Auditing skills to systematically review drawing sets, document findings, and recommend corrective actions.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills to collaborate with designers, project managers, and site teams, and to clearly report quality issues and solutions.
* Relevant experience in interior fit\-out, architecture, or civil/interior design projects, especially in drawing review or design coordination, is highly beneficial.
* A diploma or degree in Interior Design, Architecture, Civil Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in design and drafting tools (such as AutoCAD or similar software) and familiarity with industry standards and building codes are advantageous.
* Attention to detail, ability to work to deadlines, and commitment to maintaining high quality standards are essential.

 The candidate will act as a strategic partner to business leadership, driving enterprise\-wide excellence by enabling:
   

  

* Scalable and resilient process ecosystems
* Data\-driven and insight\-led decision\-making
* Adoption of digital, AI, and automation\-led improvements where required
* A culture of continuous improvement, ownership, and accountability


 The role requires balancing governance with agility, ensuring that processes evolve with business growth without creating complexity or operational friction.
   

  

 The job requires the candidate to use a combination of logic, analysis, experience and wisdom to provide overall direction and effective solutions for ensuring compliance and leveraging best practices.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The candidate would be responsible for identifying and driving improvement initiatives across the organization in line with business requirements. This would require demonstration of results in terms of cycle time reduction, reduced costs and improved quality.
   

  

 The candidate will also verify that Quantitative Goals are set for various projects and functions are met, report deviations and identify areas of improvement. At the organization level, the candidate will review \& approve the baseline reports / improvement plans and ensure effectiveness of process improvement plans.
   

  

 The candidate will be responsible for establishing, implementing and maintaining Management Systems (ISO 9001, 14000, 18001, 31001\) in line with the requirement. This will also involve prioritizing process changes, planning for release and deployment and institutionalization of processes and best practices as per the organizational direction and road map.
   

  

 The job would require regular analysis of training needs on various aspects of process frameworks and other business needs and that these are planned and conducted to meet business objectives.
   

  

 Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills are essential for this role as the candidate would be mentoring/training other members of the team, interacting with People Managers and People Leaders. The candidate should be proficient in generating and delivering effective training programs, client presentations and reviewing process documentation.
   

  

 Key Competencies / Skills
   

  

 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Good understanding of industry standards like ISO models (9001, 14001, 45001\) and project governance/ execution processes
* Process definition, deployment and institutionalization
* Risk Management (ISO 31000\)

title: Quality Assurance Lead
description:
**Quality Assurance Lead** 




  




* **The Opportunity**



 Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're building the world's most admired tattoo company.
 



 With 16\+ premium studios, a team of 160\+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become a global lifestyle brand, we believe great businesses are built by great leaders.
 



 We're not looking for managers who simply maintain operations.
 



 We're looking for leaders who build businesses, develop people, obsess over customer experience, and think like owners.
 



 If you thrive in high\-performance environments, love solving complex business challenges, and enjoy leading teams to extraordinary results, we'd love to meet you.
 



 As a Cluster Manager, you will be the CEO of your region.
 



  




* **The Mandate**



 You will own quality across the entire studio network end to end — compliance with how a studio is meant to run, the customer experience it delivers, the physical readiness of the floor, and the integrity of every rupee that passes through it. You'll design the audit system itself — what gets checked, how often, through what method — and build and run the team that executes it. You'll report to the Director of Operations AT, with the standing to raise what you find directly and have it acted on.
 



  




* **What you'll be doing**



 Checking every studio against its own standard — how it opens, how it closes, the process it's supposed to run — through visits that are sometimes announced and sometimes not, in person and on camera, so what you see is what's actually happening, not what's being reported.
 



 Following through on what you find. A gap logged and forgotten is worse than no audit at all — you'll drive every finding to a real fix, and when the same issue shows up in more than one studio, you'll catch that it's not five separate problems but one system that needs to change.
 



 Defining what a great customer experience looks like in an Aliens studio, and checking every visit against it — real visits and unannounced ones — so the standard is more than a document nobody's held to.
 



 Owning the physical readiness of every studio — hygiene, safety, the equipment a session actually depends on — and catching what's broken before a customer does.
 



 Protecting the integrity of what happens at the till. Every rupee collected reaches the business, every invoice gets raised, every number in the system can be trusted — and when it can't, you're the one who catches it and escalates it.
 



 Building the entire audit system from nothing — the calendar, the criteria, the dashboards that make every studio's status visible without anyone needing to ask — designed to keep running whether or not you're the one checking that day.
 



 Hiring and growing the team that makes all of this real at network scale — holding the bar on every seat, and coaching the kind of discipline that makes an audit actually mean something.
 



  




* **What we're looking for**



 You've done this before — run quality or audit work across multiple locations, not a single site. You know that a standard which only holds where someone's watching isn't a standard at all.
 



 Your eye for detail borders on the obsessive. You catch what other people walk past — the small drift that becomes the big failure six months later.
 



 You think in systems, not incidents. You don't just find problems; you build the process that catches the next hundred before they happen.
 



 You are exacting with numbers, especially where money and trust intersect. When a finding is inconvenient for someone — a studio manager, a high performer, someone senior — you report what you found, not what's comfortable.
 



 Most people who are good at meticulous, detailed inspection work are not naturally the kind of person who can also design a system and build a team. This role needs both — the person who'll walk a studio floor at 7am checking a washroom, and the person who'll sit down and design the dashboard that makes a hundred studios' worth of that visible at once.
 



 Bachelor's degree, with a track record in quality assurance, audit or operations across a multi\-location retail, hospitality or service business. That's the baseline — what we're actually hiring is the judgment that comes from having done this at scale before.
 



  




* **What success looks like**



 every studio in the network is audited on a published cadence, with nothing left unaccounted for. The compliance status of any studio is answerable in a moment, without needing to call and check. Cash and billing integrity is verified everywhere, and the leaks that used to go unnoticed get caught before they become losses.
 



 The audit system runs as a system — not as you personally visiting every studio, but as a team you've built and trained, working to a standard you designed and can walk away from without it slipping.
 



  




* **Practical details**



 Bachelor's degree, with 6–10 years in quality assurance, audit or operations,
 



 Education: Bachelor's degree, any discipline
 



 A quality or process\-audit certification — Six Sigma, ISO auditing or equivalent \- This is optional, However this is an added advantage

**Company Description** 
 Subham Group of Industries is a rice milling group based in India, focused on delivering high\-quality rice products to domestic and international markets. The company offers opportunities for emerging professionals to contribute to process improvements and technology adoption within a growing agribusiness environment.

**About Ether** 




 Ether is a school operating system built by educators and engineers to simplify how schools
 



 run. From admissions to communication, we help schools save time, reduce chaos, and focus
 



 on what matters most — learning and leadership.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We’re building a high\-performance, multi\-product SaaS platform that powers how schools
 



 operate. As a Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst, you’ll ensure that Ether’s products deliver a seamless,
 



 reliable experience to schools, parents, and students. You’ll own testing of key product
 



 modules, design and execute test strategies, and leverage automation and AI tools to
 



 improve testing speed and accuracy.
 



  





 You’ll collaborate closely with developers, designers, and product managers — ensuring that
 



 quality is built into every stage of development, not checked at the end.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Own quality for major product modules across Ether’s SaaS ecosystem.
* Design, document, and execute manual and automated test cases for web and mobile applications.
* Collaborate with engineers early in the development cycle to define acceptance



 criteria and catch issues proactively.
 


* Identify, document, and track defects, ensuring timely resolution and clear



 communication.
 


* Leverage AI\-assisted tools (Lambda Test, etc.) for test case generation, regression



 testing, and defect analysis.
 


* Build and maintain automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright).
* Ensure thorough cross\-browser, API, and performance testing.
* Participate in CI/CD pipeline validation and release certification.
* Continuously evolve testing processes and mentor junior QA engineers.



  





**Who You Are** 



* 4\-8 years of experience in software testing (manual \+ automation).
* Proven experience in testing web and mobile applications, preferably in SaaS



 environments.
 


* Strong understanding of QA methodologies, SDLC, and Agile processes.
* Hands\-on with tools like Postman, JMeter, Selenium, or Cypress.
* Familiar with API testing, database validation (SQL), and defect management systems (JIRA, ClickUp, or similar).
* Comfortable working closely with developers and product managers to define and verify quality outcomes.
* Passionate about using AI tools (e.g., Testim, Copilot, Cursor) to improve QA efficiency.
* Strong analytical and communication skills with a problem\-solving mindset.



  





**Bonus If You Have (Not mandatory, but helpful)** 



* Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS or EdTech systems.
* Familiarity with AWS environments, CI/CD integration, and performance/load testing.
* Experience setting up test automation from scratch.
* Knowledge of data privacy, security, or compliance testing.
* Exposure to API mocking and service virtualisation tools.



  





**What’s in it for You** 



* Be part of Ether’s founding QA team, shaping the company’s quality culture.
* Build for real impact in education across India.
* Learn from cross\-functional teams and adopt modern AI\-driven QA practices.
* Grow into a Principal QA or QA Lead role as Ether scales.



  





 Passionate about helping schools succeed? Let’s talk. This is your chance to be part of something meaningful from the start.

 About GreyLabs AI
